propos: The code is shared in the network's WhatsApp group, or handed out by IFDD at the preparatory workshop. It opens the discussions, the reserved documents and the reports.

champ.aide: Eight characters, dashes included. Case and spaces do not matter.

hors-connexion: Entering a code requires a network connection. Nothing has been sent yet, and no access has been opened.
sans-compte: A code is added to an account. Create yours or sign in, then come back to enter it.
me-connecter: I already have an account — Sign in

pas-de-code.propos: Ask for it in your group, or from IFDD at the preparatory workshop.
